metric: AUPRC on the fire class (sklearn average_precision_score) and per-class F1; accuracy is reported only as a warning, since the classes run two to one
holdout: the published Mesogeos time holdout, target days in 2021 and 2022; train 2006 to 2019 and validation 2020 contribute no items
subsampling: items.jsonl is in target-date order, so take a fold rather than a prefix; fold is sha256(item_id) mod 10 and each fold keeps the class balance and the season mix

constant_score.note: any constant probability; the AUPRC floor is the positive share

calendar_month_prior.note: positive rate per calendar month fit on the 2006 to 2019 training years only, applied to the holdout by month

last_day_t2m.note: the last day's maximum 2 m temperature as the score, sign chosen on the training years

modis_lst_day_count.note: count of window days with a MODIS daytime land surface temperature. Cloud drives the gaps, so missingness tracks fire weather; this is an artifact of the source worth stating, not a defect to engineer away

published_baseline_note: kondylatos2023mesogeos Table 1, on the 2738-negative version of this same holdout. Comparable to within the 13 extra negatives kept here.
